name: outputs.Proofs.FreyaTunedComplexity.literal_time_bound
type_text:
∀ (p : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaInputs.Family),
  0 < p.m →
    0 < p.n →
      0 < p.S →
        p.S ≤ p.m →
          0 < p.ρ →
            p.ρ ≤ 1 →
              0 ≤ p.Lminus →
                0 ≤ p.Lpm →
                  0 ≤ p.Δ →
                    0 < p.ε →
                      outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.largeSample p.m p.n →
                        ∀ (f : Fin p.m → outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Space p.d → ℝ) (τ : Fin p.n → ENNReal),
                          Monotone τ →
                            ∀
                              (O :
                                OracleTemplate.Oracle (Option (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Request p.d p.m p.n))
                                  (outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.Reply p.d p.n)),
                              outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.PrimitiveService f τ O →
                                ∀ (N : ℕ),
                                  outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.eventLimit
                                        (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p false) ≤
                                      N →
                                    let q := outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyRaw p false;
                                    have P := ↑(outputs.Proofs.FreyaCollectors.executionLaw q O);
                                    ∫⁻ (z : outputs.Algorithms.FreyaRandomness.Seed q.K × ((k : ℕ) → O.Seed 1 k)),
                                        ↑(OracleTemplate.execute O (outputs.Algorithms.FreyaPage.factory q) (fun x => N)
                                              z.1 z.2).2 ∂P ≤
                                      10 * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +
                                        ENNReal.ofReal
                                            (10 * p.Δ *
                                                outputs.Algorithms.FreyaTuning.familyCoefficient p.toBase p.S p.ρ /
                                              p.ε) *
                                          (ENNReal.ofReal p.ρ * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.m +
                                            ENNReal.ofReal (1 - p.ρ) * outputs.Proofs.FreyaModel.equilibriumTime τ ↑p.S)
